limitations: L4 is exercised offline synthetic arithmetic only, never bioequivalence, interchangeability, product quality, regulatory acceptance or clinical relevance.
CV and unit controls do not establish representative sampling, instrument accuracy, physical or clinical validity. Zero variance in a positive column is valid CV zero, never evidence.
Hashes cannot establish historical freeze timing or true source independence. Independent review remains unavailable.

Conservative case-insensitive English whole-word/prefix families: caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, drive/drives/driv*, induc*. Also truth, physical validity, patient benefit, bioequiv*, interchange*, product quality and accept*. The gate includes negations and is incomplete.
Unavailable evidence requires unavailable claims. Computed agreement and review approval never support positive claims; one synthetic fixture never establishes replication.
Inputs are read-only, bounded to 64 MiB each, 256 MiB aggregate and 4000000 JSON values; hardlink aliases share initial reads and parsing.
